snippet.title: Moon & The Fractured Reincarnation - Announcement Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3614050/Moon__The_Fractured_Reincarnation/


LORE

The Moon Goddess seemingly distraught, tears apart a barrier between worlds , causing planes to appear in different dimensions and realities entirely - while doing so she unleashes her Celestial beings, causing the human plane to further mutate as Magik from wilted realms seep into Midgar. The world today now exists as a cohesion between a new kind of normalcy, willfully forged, and post-apocalyptic dead-zones humans have foregone due to strong manifestations of Celestial Magik.
From time to time, Towers seem to appear out of nowhere.. those who wander into them are usually never seen or heard of again...these spaces have come to be known as Dungeons.
Dungeons, are typically only tested and tried by those known as " Scavengers" , "Wasties", or what the Goddess may deem them herself...
"Moonlit Vassals."


Explore Vast Environments: Roam freely across expansive landscapes, uncover hidden areas, and discover unique landmarks, all at your own pace.

Gather Resources & Craft: Collect materials from the world around you—whether it’s wood, minerals, or plants—and craft tools, weapons, and equipment to enhance your experience.

Build & Create: Design and construct your own structures, modify the environment to suit your needs, or even establish your own base to call home.

Engage in Combat & Survival: Face off against enemies, wildlife, or other players, while managing your health, hunger, and other survival elements to stay alive and thrive in the world.

Experience Dynamic Weather & Time: Watch the world change with a shifting day-night cycle and ever-changing weather conditions, which can impact your strategy and gameplay.

Embark on Quests & Objectives: Dive into story-driven missions or take on side quests, exploring deeper layers of the world and unlocking new content and experiences.

Interact with NPCs & Join Factions: Meet a variety of characters, form alliances, trade goods, or join factions that will shape your journey and provide new opportunities.

Trade & Manage Economy: Buy, sell, and trade items with NPCs or other players, influencing the in-game economy and acquiring valuable resources.

Take Part in Dynamic Events: Encounter random events such as natural disasters, surprise enemy ambushes, or rare opportunities that make each playthrough feel fresh and exciting.

Make Choices that Matter: Your actions have consequences, from altering the environment to changing relationships with NPCs or even impacting the story, ensuring your journey is unique.

Outlaw Stars: Wanted System: Engage in outlaw activities and risk becoming a fugitive! The more chaos you cause, the higher your bounty will rise. In this system, law enforcement and bounty hunters will be on the lookout for you, and how you handle your "wanted" status will affect the world around you. Escape the law, or face the consequences—it's all up to you.

Alignment System: Will you choose the path of order, neutrality, or chaos? Your actions will shape your alignment, influencing how NPCs react to you and what options are available in the game. Whether you follow the law, embrace chaos, or balance between the two, your choices will determine your role in the world.

Demon Contracting: Enter into a powerful pact with a demon partner to aid you in combat. These demons bring unique abilities to help you fight, but be cautious—contracts come with their own risks and challenges.

Demon Fusion: Take your bond with your demon partner to the next level by fusing together, becoming stronger and gaining access to powerful abilities. While fused, you and your demon become one, significantly boosting your power, but you won’t be able to use your demon as a separate companion during this time.

No Class System: Forget rigid class restrictions! You can shape your character any way you want by focusing on the skills and abilities that best suit your playstyle. The freedom is yours to define your character’s strengths and growth.

Life Skills: Level up your life skills naturally as you go about the game, simply by doing things like fishing, farming, or even interacting with the world. The more you practice, the better you get—no need to worry about specific skill trees or forced leveling.

Fishing: Take a moment to unwind and enjoy fishing in a variety of environments, from serene lakes to ocean shores. Your fishing skills will improve over time, unlocking rare catches and special rewards.

Bug Catching: Explore the world and catch insects as part of your journey. Bugs can be collected, studied, or even used for crafting unique items—perfect for curious players or those looking to complete collections.

Farming: Grow your own crops, raise animals, and create a thriving farm. Whether you're cultivating food for yourself or selling it to others, farming is a peaceful yet rewarding way to build your world.

+ More.
